name: Goodcall
positioning: A no-code AI phone agent for small businesses, built and edited by describing the business to an assistant called Gabi, priced per unique customer rather than per minute.

pricing.model: Monthly plan priced per unique customer (one phone number once a month); no per-minute, per-call or token metering.
pricing.headline: Starter $79/mo (100 customers), Growth $129/mo (500), Scale $299/mo (2,000); extra customers 79c / 26c / 15c each.
planNotes: Starter: 5 workers, 1 external tool, 1 team member, 30-day call history.
Growth: 10 workers, 5 external tools, 5 team members, 90-day call history.
Scale: 20 workers, 15 external tools, 10 team members, call history with no stated cap; BAA available.
Month to month; no annual plan at time of reading.
Every plan includes a local US number.
The vendor states Starter works out to about 13c/min at four-minute calls (its own illustration, not a rate).
pricing.freeTrial: Free demo agent: build and test without paying; payment starts when a phone number is added.
whatIsExtra: Extra unique customers beyond the plan allowance.
AI usage top-ups for test runs ($5 at a time).

strengths.claim: Predictable pricing: no per-minute or token charges, and the bill counts distinct callers, so a long call costs the same as a short one.
Describing the business to the Gabi assistant builds and edits the agent in plain language, with practice calls before publishing.
Every plan includes a local phone number, and an existing business line can be forwarded to it.
Signs a HIPAA BAA on the Scale and Enterprise plans, and lists SOC 2 and HIPAA on its homepage (vendor statements).
Team roles with per-agent access, which the FAQ says lets agencies give clients access to a single agent.

limitations.claim: Numbers are local US numbers today; toll-free, Canadian and international numbers are listed as not yet available.
Self-serve number porting is not offered yet; the FAQ recommends call forwarding instead.
Native connections are Google Calendar, Google Sheets and HighLevel; other systems need an API tool or MCP server.

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: FAQ says Goodcall is HIPAA compliant with a BAA on Scale and Enterprise; homepage lists 'SOC 2 compliant'. No GDPR statement found.

telephony.providedNumbers: Local US numbers included on every plan; existing numbers are forwarded to the Goodcall number (conditional or all-call forwarding). Self-serve porting not yet available. No SIP or own-carrier connection was documented on the pages read.

stepsToLeave: No agent export feature was found in the pages read; the agent (greeting, questions, workers) would be recreated in the new platform.
Numbers: if the business number was forwarded to a Goodcall number, point the carrier's forwarding to the new platform; Goodcall numbers are local US numbers issued by Goodcall.
Calls are recorded and transcribed and viewable in the app; call history retention depends on plan (30 days, 90 days, or no stated limit).
Contact support (support@goodcall.ai) for special cases per the FAQ.

bestFor: Small US businesses and solo operators who want a quick, no-code receptionist with a flat, predictable bill.
unknowns: Whether agents or conversation data can be exported.
Whether bring-your-own carrier or SIP is supported.
Languages supported (not checked on pages read).
